searchText: where is EIP 1559 senting burned ETH to which wallet address? This is not a server for those kinds of questions, I guess ethereum stackexchange or reddit are more suitable. But to answer it anyway, it's not sent to any address. It just disappears, just like the block reward _appears_ from out of nowhere. Ahahaha🤝🤝🤝👌 so it works the same way as the fed reserve 🤝 "just like oil" would probably be more appropriate, with Ether (and other cryptocurrencies) being a commodity-based currency, not a debt-based one. care to elaborate?
